lede: Every Make plan, what each credit tier costs, and the cheapest way to get the credits you need.
calc_label: Make credits you use each month
calc_note: The calculator uses Core plan credit tiers. The Free plan covers up to 1,000 credits a month. Most actions use 1 credit and some AI features use more, so treat this as an estimate. Credits expire at the end of the term.
after_plans: Plan prices above are for 10,000 credits a month. Core, Pro and Teams each have credit tiers up to 300,000 credits a month: Core $236/month, Pro $348/month and Teams $660/month at 300,000 ($189, $278 and $528 billed yearly). Extra credits can be bought in bundles of 1,000 or 10,000. Enterprise is custom. Companies under 20 employees can get the Start-up Plan at 50% off.

compare.What you pay for: Credits: most actions use 1 credit, some AI features use more
compare.Free option: Free plan: 1,000 credits a month, runs at most every 15 minutes
compare.Cheapest paid plan: Core: $16/month, or $11/month billed yearly, for 10,000 credits
compare.Yearly billing: Cheaper per month, e.g. Core with 10,000 credits is $11 instead of $16

compare.Under 20 employees: Start-up Plan: 50% off (Make says "50% off Business")

faq: Make has a free plan. With 10,000 credits a month, Core costs $16/month ($11/month billed yearly), Pro $28/month ($20/month yearly) and Teams $51/month ($36/month yearly). Core goes up to 300,000 credits for $236/month ($189/month yearly). Enterprise is custom.
Yes. The Free plan gives 1,000 credits a month, the no-code visual builder, 3,500+ apps, routers & filters and customer support, with a 15-minute minimum interval between runs.
Most actions use 1 credit and some AI features use more. Credits expire at the end of the term, and extra credits can be bought in bundles of 1,000 or 10,000.

Core gives unlimited active scenarios, scheduling down to the minute and access to the Make API. Pro adds priority scenario execution, custom variables and full-text execution log search. Teams adds teams and team roles, and creating and sharing scenario templates.
